meshOrigin: Grand Theft Auto V OBJ exports
animationOrigin: MakeHuman/vsim skeleton; Mixamo Walk/Run retargeted from Three.js r180 Soldier joint trajectories with relaxed shoulder/elbow/palm constraints; corrected MakeHuman idle and original donor wave; not original GTA V animations
conversion: DDS/TGA to embedded PNG, neutral-pose alignment, nearest-surface skin transfer

deformationCheck.method: CPU-skinned GLB vertices at walk times 5/24 and 20/24 seconds; remeasured after elbow rebinding

armBindingFix.method: Refit donor elbow origins and arm bind frames to the measured sleeve centreline; rebuild inverse bind matrices and constant joint translation tracks. Meshes, normals, UVs, textures, skin weights and rotation clips are unchanged.
